answer: Sponsor liability stops Sybils: a joiner locks 25.000 POA, a sponsor countersigns 25.000, returned after 12 epochs. A jury flag burns the joiner bond, splits the sponsor bond: half to the reporter, half burned. The network catches the first zephyr of each registration wave and auto-flags fingerprint clusters; a whisper of collusion triggers review. Trust stands on basalt, each identity a destructible stake. A 1.000-identity farm risks 50.000.000 POA (1.000 x 2 x 25.000), losing everything; one honest agent risks 25.000 once. Limitation: wealthy attackers can buy fake sponsors via middlemen.
